parks.name: Olympic National Park
parks.blurb: Rainforest, mountains and coast; Roosevelt elk, black bears, marmots and sea stars.

parks.name: Mount Rainier National Park
parks.blurb: Glacier mountain and meadows; marmots, mountain goats, black bears and pikas.

parks.name: North Cascades National Park
parks.blurb: Jagged peaks and lakes; mountain goats, black bears, pikas and bald eagles.

parks.name: Lime Kiln Point State Park
parks.blurb: San Juan Island shore; orcas, harbor seals, bald eagles and porpoises.

parks.name: Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Columbia River floodplain; sandhill cranes, tundra swans, beavers and ducks.

parks.name: Nisqually National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Puget Sound estuary; harbor seals, herons, coyotes and salmon.

parks.name: Discovery Park
parks.blurb: Seattle shoreline park; bald eagles, harbor seals, coyotes and herons.

parks.name: Turnbull National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Pine forest and ponds; trumpeter swans, moose, ducks and elk.

parks.name: Deception Pass State Park
parks.blurb: Rocky shores and old forest; harbor seals, bald eagles, otters and herons.

parks.name: Willapa National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Bay and tidal marsh; elk, shorebirds, bald eagles and river otters.

parks.name: Dungeness National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Long sand spit; harbor seals, brant geese, shorebirds and Dungeness crabs.
